BCP-22 JJ Wetherholt, St. Louis Cardinals...' verbatim) and BCP-127 = Emil Morales. This is the PAPER Bowman product's own Bowman Chrome Prospects insert (BCP-1 through BCP-152); the DIFFERENT insert range BCP-153 through BCP-252 belongs to the 2025 Bowman CHROME product itself and is staged separately in this same package's 2025-bowman-chrome-baseball.csv sibling file -- the two ranges are non-overlapping subsets of the same BCP prefix inside two different registered setKeys (bowman vs bowman-chrome), not a collision.
beckettCardListOnly: Beckett's xlsx is a card list (cardNumber + player), never a parallel/print-run column -- 'parallel' is blank on every row here by design. This stages the missing PLAIN BASE card at each BCP number; the colored-refractor ladder itself already exists in the catalog per classified-final.json's own notes (Superfractor for 2025 BCP-22; Silver/Blue/Red/Black/Green/Yellow/Printing Plates/Gold for 2017 BCP127) and is not restaged here to avoid a duplicate-source collision with whatever already carries those names.

newVsExisting.method: Every row in this file mints a blank-parallel (plain Base) row at a cardNumber the catalog already carries under a DIFFERENT (colored) parallel per classified-final.json's own note -- so by definition every (cardNumber, blank-parallel) cell this file writes is NEW versus committed data; the (cardNumber, coloredParallel) cells already in the catalog are UNCHANGED (not restaged here).
